newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Boland unit plans to double business in '97.
newsitem.headline: Boland unit plans to double business in '97.

text.p: Boland Financial Services (BFS), the specialised debt and equity finance unit of Boland Bank Holdings Ltd, plans to double its business in 1997, it said on Tuesday.
"BFS plans to double its business during 1997 -- its second year of operation -- by continuing to focus on its core growth areas of investment banking and structured finance," it said in a statement.

With 1.4 billion rands worth of deals transacted since its launch in November 1995, the company also planned to increase its international business which was expected to represent half its operations within three years, it said.
"South Africa has reached a skills level which enables it to market financial service internationally, and BFS will be Boland Bank's international vehicle."
BFS has already forged links with banks based in New York, Dublin and London and is considering further associations with operations in Amsterdam, Geneva, Singapore and Kuala Lumpur.
